[[File:False_Kadann.jpg|thumb|The pseudo-Kadann crushing a ball of chalk]]
{{Quote|I drank a bit of the milk and used another piece of cake to get rid of the thick chalky taste.|Corran Horn|<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Chalk''' was a soft, powdery substance that could be compressed into solid shapes. Items made of compressed chalk could easily be turned into their initial dusty state by simply crushing them.<ref name="LCJ">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref> In its natural form, chalk was white,<ref name="DB">In ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'', [[Qordis]]' pale skin was described as "chalky".</ref> but it could be [[Color/Legends|colored]] with pigments.<ref name="LCJ" /> The precious [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]], one of the primary constituent materials of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]], was described as chalk-like.<ref name="DM:SH">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref>

The pseudo-[[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]], the false [[Supreme Prophet]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]], was known to keep [[Color/Legends|colored]] chalk balls on a low table besides his throne. He would often crush the balls in his hands until they crumbled to dust, using the color symbolism to convey certain messages.<ref name="LCJ" /> Pieces of chalk were also used as primitive writing instruments, notably used to write on scoreboards during sporting events.<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> Sometimes, pieces of chalk were also used to mark one's way physically in labyrinthine places.<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

According to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], artificial [[Nerf-milk/Legends|nerf-milk]] protein beverage tasted like chalk.<ref name="IJ" />
